neighbours.label: the second piece of a word that starts with 'Alo'/'alo'/'Elo' (the 'ha' of Aloha, the 'loe' of aloe, Elohim), a spelling-unit pole
fire: The hotel staff placed flower leis on us and said Aloha as we arrived.
After the beach she rubbed cool aloe on her red shoulders.
Our neighbor runs a small shop called Aloha Surf Rentals.
This shampoo is made with aloe and coconut oil.
Every letter from Hawaii ended with the word Aloha and a drawing.
Keep an aloe plant on the windowsill for minor burns.
The radio host signed off with a cheerful Aloha to his listeners.
In the psalm the name Elohim is used for God.
quiet: The hotel staff placed flower leis on us and said hello as we arrived.
After the beach she rubbed cool cream on her red shoulders.
Our neighbor runs a small shop called Pacific Surf Rentals.
This shampoo is made with honey and coconut oil.
Every letter from Hawaii ended with the word love and a drawing.
Keep a basil plant on the windowsill for cooking.
The radio host signed off with a cheerful goodbye to his listeners.
In the psalm the name Lord is used for God.
